headline: Trinidad Nears Natural Gas Agreement With Venezuela Pending US Approval
summary: Trinidad and Tobago's Energy Minister Roodal Moonilal stated that the country will soon sign a gas measurement agreement with Venezuela, though actual offshore gas production still requires separate authorization from the United States.
why: Trinidad is a major exporter of liquefied natural gas and petrochemicals, relying on access to cross-border Venezuelan offshore gas fields to offset domestic production declines.

impacts.name: Trinidad and Tobago
impacts.why: Progress on Venezuelan gas agreements supports feedgas supply for Trinidad's export LNG and ammonia facilities.
